projects.title: Rocket Airbrakes
projects.summary: Active in-flight apogee control for a liquid rocket: three panels driven by one servo through a linear cam-and-slot plate, with CFD-derived drag models and STM32 flight firmware.
bullets: One low-power servo drives all 3 panels in sync through a spinning plate with 3 modified spiral slots (linear extension per degree)
Ansys CFD with a teammate: kept the centre of pressure safely behind the CG and mapped Cd vs extension for the trajectory model
Co-wrote STM32 FreeRTOS firmware: Kalman-filter state estimation, RK4 trajectory prediction, PID panel control
2025: designed the 4-layer central avionics PCB in KiCad (power efficiency 66% to 95%, onboard IMU over I2C, external AHRS over UART) for the roll-control canards
2024 launch: propellant underfill meant the airbrakes correctly stayed retracted the whole flight

projects.title: Automated Measurement System
projects.summary: A hands-off tolerance-inspection station: computer vision orients the part, a force-sensing clamp on a rotary encoder measures it, and out-of-spec parts are logged to a server.
bullets: Lead firmware: C++ on the ESP32 and the VEX V5 brain for both motors, dimension derivation and the on-machine GUI
Custom uni-directional 2-wire clock + data protocol (I2C-inspired) because the V5 brain exposes only digital I/O
OpenCV (Python) finds the part rotation and sends the angle to the ESP32 over web sockets
Clamp stops on firm contact via force sensing; encoder rotation is mapped to linear distance
Out-of-spec parts: image + failing dimension logged to a remote server and flagged on the display

projects.title: Segway System Modelling & Optimization
projects.summary: Derived, linearized and simulated a human transporter, then tuned thrust force and lean angle for maximum distance without falling, cross-checked against an acausal SimulationX model.
bullets: Hand-derived nonlinear kinematic and kinetic equations; linearized with a small-angle approximation
Simulink sweep: coarse pass, then 160-180 N in 0.5 N steps and 0.2-0.8 rad in 0.05 rad steps
Simulink optimum: 12.3 m at 170 N thrust (lean angle reported as -0.2 rad)
SimulationX acausal model (no hand-derived EOMs) as a sanity check: 9.15 m at 110 N and 11 degrees
Python to parse, clean and plot the SimulationX sweep data
